metadata.scenario: A woman calls for the first time asking about post-partum support services. She just had twins and is overwhelmed. She wants to know if CareFirst has anyone who can help with newborn care and light housekeeping while she recovers. The receptionist explains their mother-baby program. The caller sounds relieved. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, um, my name is Lisa. I just had twins, and I'm feeling really overwhelmed. I was wondering if you have any postpartum support services? Congratulations on your twins, Lisa! Yes, we do offer postpartum support services. Can you tell me what specific help you're looking for? Well, I could really use someone to help with newborn care and maybe a bit of light housekeeping while I recover. Absolutely, we have a specialized mother-baby program for situations just like yours. Our caregivers can assist with newborn care and light housekeeping. That sounds perfect! How does it work? Our caregivers can come to your home on a scheduled basis, typically for a few hours at a time. We can also tailor the service to your needs. That’s really helpful. What are the costs associated with this service? The pricing for our postpartum support services starts at $28 per hour for light housekeeping and newborn care. Okay, that sounds manageable. Do you have caregivers who speak Spanish? Yes, we can definitely provide Spanish-speaking caregivers to ensure you're comfortable. Oh, that’s a relief! I really need that support right now. I’m glad to hear that! Would you like me to send you more information or assist you in scheduling your first visit? Yes, please! I’d like to go ahead and schedule someone to start as soon as possible. Great! When are you hoping to start? I’d love to have someone come tomorrow if possible. Let me check our availability. We do have a caregiver available for tomorrow afternoon. Does that work for you? Yes, that would be wonderful! Perfect! I’ll go ahead and schedule that for you. Can I have your email address to send you the confirmation? Sure, it's lisa.gonzalez@email.com. Thank you, Lisa. I’ll send the confirmation and some additional resources about our services to that email. Thank you so much, Margaret. You've really helped ease my stress. You’re very welcome! We’re here to support you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that's all for now. I really appreciate your help! Of course, Lisa! We look forward to working with you. Have a wonderful day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
